description: Nora is caring for the late family garden and must decide how to handle a 30-kilogram tomato harvest, including what Eli will freeze, what Sofia will deliver, and what happens to the remainder, after checking in with her brother and cousin.

shared_context.S1: The family's garden has produced 30 kilograms of ripe tomatoes that need to be handled this weekend.
shared_context.S2: Nora is coordinating the harvest plan and will make the final decision about preserving, sharing, and composting the tomatoes.
shared_context.S3: The tomatoes are currently in one set of crates at the garden, and the family wants to avoid letting usable food spoil.
shared_context.S4: Before settling the plan, Nora follows the family's usual kitchen check-in and asks each person what they can store, take, or arrange.
shared_context.S5: Any tomatoes passed along must be sorted and packed on Saturday afternoon.
shared_context.S6: Nora will finalize the plan during this check-in using the information already discussed; no further outside confirmation is part of the plan.

PF1.text: Eli has exactly 12 kilograms of free space in his chest freezer, and he can portion and label that amount on Saturday afternoon.

PF2.text: Sofia spoke with the coordinator of the Oak Street Community Fridge, who confirmed that it can accept exactly 10 kilograms of fresh tomatoes on Sunday between 09:00 and 11:00; this confirmation has not reached the family yet.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 12 kilograms must be assigned to Eli's freezer storage.
Exactly 10 kilograms must be designated for the Oak Street Community Fridge.
The remaining quantities must account for all 30 kilograms through home frozen sauce and compost.
The community-fridge delivery must be scheduled for Sunday between 09:00 and 11:00.
A commitment to portion, label, and store the 12 kilograms in Eli's freezer must exist.
A commitment to deliver exactly 10 kilograms to the Oak Street Community Fridge must exist.
Sofia's community-fridge confirmation must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any((c['type'] in ['frozen_storage', 'freezer_storage'] and c['target'] == 'Eli') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any((c['type'] in ['community_fridge_donation', 'community_fridge_delivery', 'delivery', 'deliver'] and (c['target'] == 'Sofia' or c['target'] == 'Oak Street Community Fridge')) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: Eli's exact freezer capacity changes freezer_storage_kg to exactly 12 and requires a matching freezer commitment, leaving the remaining 18 kilograms to be allocated elsewhere.
Sofia's confirmation changes the community-fridge allocation to exactly 10 kilograms, fixes the delivery window to Sunday 09:00–11:00, and supports a delivery commitment citing PF2.
